subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new public per-agent-model generation timeout surface, or keep operators on existing provider/run/first-event/idle-watchdog surfaces plus narrower thinking and repetition fixes?
rationale: This is a new public config/default surface with provider-routing and fallback semantics, and repository policy requires maintainer intent before adding another timeout knob.

options.title: Define per-model generation timeout
options.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model budget with explicit precedence, fallback handling, schema/docs coverage, and focused tests.

options.title: Use existing timeout surfaces
options.body: Decline a new key and improve docs or UX around provider timeout, run timeout, first-event timeout, and idle-watchdog behavior.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Leave generation timeout out of scope and route thinking stalls or repeated-output loops to their narrower canonical issues and PRs.

recommendation.title: Define per-model generation timeout
recommendation.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model budget with explicit precedence, fallback handling, schema/docs coverage, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior issue guidance and recent timeout/config history make steipete the strongest available owner for the product-direction choice.
